news.title: Consensus EPS estimates increase by 15%
news.body: The consensus outlook for fiscal year 2026 has been updated. 2026 EPS estimate increased from ₹24.40 to ₹28.10. Revenue forecast steady at ₹93.8b. Net income forecast to grow 3.0% next year vs 34% growth forecast for Specialty Retail industry in India. Consensus price target broadly unchanged at ₹815. Share price fell 3.8% to ₹567 over the past week.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹12.59 (vs ₹6.34 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹12.59 (up from ₹6.34 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹33.3b (up 37% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.71b (up 99% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 5.1% (up from 3.5% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 20% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Specialty Retail industry in India.

news.title: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited Appoints Deepak Kumar Vijay as Chief Financial Officer Effective January 24, 2026
news.body: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited appointed Mr. Deepak Kumar Vijay as Chief Financial Officer (Key Managerial Personnel) effective January 24, 2026. Deepak Vijay is an accomplished finance leader with over 18 years of cross-industry experience across apparel sourcing, retail, manufacturing, and hospitality sectors. He is a Chartered Accountant with executive education from IIM Ahmedabad and has completed CFA Level II. Over the course of his career, he has held senior and leadership roles with globally respected organizations including Techno Design (subsidiary of PDS Limited), Marks & Spencer (India – JV with Reliance Retail), Fossil Group, and IHCL (Taj Hotels). news.title: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited Appoints Aditya Saurabh Gadgil As Additional Director Effective January 23, 2026
news.body: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited appointed Mr. Aditya Saurabh Gadgil (DIN: 10052553) as Additional Director (Non-Executive Non-Independent) effective January 23, 2026. Aditya, a proud alumnus of Symbiosis College of Arts & Commerce, has successfully completed his 12th grade in Commerce. As the seventh generation to carry forward his family’s rich business legacy, he is deeply rooted in its traditions while embracing modern perspectives. Currently, he is pursuing his BFA in Film/Video from Pratt Institute in Brooklyn, New York having cumulative GPA 9.8/10, expanding his knowledge and global exposure.
